reviewNotes: Checked 2026-08-16. Queried the public Overpass API for named tourism, historic, leisure, amenity, and shop objects within the defined Tokyo and Seoul bounding boxes. Only name, coordinates, and OSM tag-derived category are imported. Reviews, photos, user data, HTML, snippets, opening hours, prices, and accessibility claims are excluded. Attribution and ODbL share-alike obligations are recorded in data/catalog-v1/NOTICE.md.
